deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics: no formulas, computations or derivations. It continues section '3. (Erdseele)' of Riemann's natural-philosophical/psychological fragment, which develops Fechner-inspired ideas. The argument runs as follows.

(1) From the explanatory principles stated on the previous page, Riemann draws a consequence. Geistesmassen ('mind-masses') produced in nerve processes persist with their internal connection unchanged. Therefore the souls of organic beings, i.e. the interwoven Geistesmassen formed during their lives, persist after death. A marginal note adds: 'Their isolated persistence does not suffice.'

(2) The organic world develops according to a plan, with earlier experience serving as the basis for later 'creations'. To explain this, Riemann postulates that these Geistesmassen enter a larger interwoven Geistesmasse, the Earth-soul (Erdseele). There they serve a higher mental life under the same laws by which our nerve-produced Geistesmassen serve our own mental life.

(3) Analogy 1: seeing a red surface. The Geistesmassen produced in many individual primitive nerve fibres combine into one Geistesmasse that appears in thought all at once. Likewise, the Geistesmassen of the individuals of a plant genus from a climatically similar region combine in the Earth-soul into a single overall impression.

(4) Analogy 2: different sense perceptions of one object unite into one image of it. Likewise, all plants of a region give the Earth-soul a finely worked-out picture of its climatic and chemical state. This is meant to explain how the plan for later creations develops out of the Earth's earlier life.

(5) Constraint: persistence of existing Geistesmassen needs no material carrier. But any combination of them, at least of heterogeneous ones, can occur only through new Geistesmassen produced in a common nervous (physical) process.

(6) For reasons to be given later, the substrate of mental activity can only be sought in ponderable matter. The next page uses this to locate the Earth-soul's substrate beneath the solid crust.
errors: No mathematical errors are possible, since there is no mathematics. The argument is speculative natural philosophy: the Earth-soul hypothesis rests on analogy, not demonstration. Riemann himself flags that isolated persistence of souls is insufficient.

results.what: Persistence of souls (interwoven Geistesmassen) after death, and their entry into a collective Earth-soul that integrates the impressions of organisms, as the explanation of purposive development of organic nature.
Combination of heterogeneous Geistesmassen requires a common physical (nervous) process in ponderable matter; mere persistence needs no carrier.
results.modern_name: Psychophysical parallelism / substrate requirement for binding

deep.surprise_reason: Purely philosophical text with no mathematics. Riemann's Fechner-influenced Geistesmassen/Erdseele speculations are known: philosophical fragments on psychology, metaphysics and the Erdseele appear in the Weber–Dedekind Gesammelte Werke and are discussed in the literature on Riemann and Fechner.
transcription_corrections: In the line '...kann nur mittelst eines in einem gemeinschaftlichen Nerven- (physischen) Process erzeugter Geistesmassen geschehen', the image appears to read 'mittelst neuer in einem gemeinschaftlichen...' rather than 'eines'. 'neuer ... erzeugter Geistesmassen' is also the grammatically consistent reading.
The marginal note is written in the image as '[[Am Rande]]: Ihr isolirtes Fortbestehen genügt nicht.' Its content is correctly transcribed.
